content: Kristus Mele Samol

Molow la yami irel Kristus mele ye foru bo habe kkel, ngo hachangcheng la yal mele ye hopossohmi. Espritus Santus la lamliyel Kristus mele yesa foru bo habe sew chog mo iy. Ha ffaho fengal ngo ha hamomayi fengali yami hagiyeg.
Ikekafael pechehmi bo habe foru bo be kkel yai rraey irel mala be sew chog yami luluwal, ngo ye hafedeg yami hachangi fengalugmi ngo ha depsew chog irel mekla ha luluwaley.
Ha towe foru mekla ye budoh mo irel luluwalel chog llufulumi hare ye budoh mo irel depel habos. Habe far hatetalo yami luluwal ngal semal mo semal, ngo ha towe luluwaley le ha fel mo imor yarmat.
Ha towe luluwaley chog mmalmi llufulumi; ha kemahoy mele ye hafohoy semal mo semal iyang bo habe ma tipingi fengalugmi.
Ye momay le wegdegmi ila yebe wochog wegdegel Kristus Jesus:

content.text: Pangal yad ngo ye mel chog le iy Deus,
ngo ligdi bo yete hakkela le iy yebe hafedeg ngal Deus.
Iy mele yal luluwal le yebe ligdiloh pangal falmay la yal,
bela mel le ye igegel semal boy.
Ye sala sub bo yarmat le ye yigegelgich chog yarmat. Yela mel le ye totol ngo yema taelenga chog yalol Deus yee,
la mes le ye mes wol krud.
Ila fal le Deus ye hatagitadah bo yebe hartael tagiyet mo wol laeng,
ngo ye hadeda ngali yid we ye hartael tagiyet mo imol pangal yid.
Panger rechokla re mel wol laeng,
mo ikla re mel wol talop, mo ikla re mel falyayulol, ngo rebe hasubgudiy rebe hasrowu yid la Jesus,
ngo panger ngo rebe kaptaloh le Jesus Kristus mele Samol. Rebe sor mele irel Jesus,
ngo rebe halehaloh le ye ssor Deus le Temach.

content: Ha Bele Werloh Bo Hawrel Faileng

Hami re wol maryarey, pangal yad ngo hama taelenga yaloy irel yodwe imel iremi. Ngo yesa palleng tot fal le habe talenga yaloy igla, le ila mwo itay mel iremi. Ha taboloh chog yami yengang luwul yami motog Deus mo rusmes irel yee, la hola yodla habe mmal irel pangal formel iyang,
bo pangal yad ngo Deus ye yengang luwulumi bo yebe wigid dipmi bo habe foru mala iy ye dipli.
Ha foru pangal formel ngo ha towe ma hapaliyel fengal, hare ha hachocho fengal,
ila ngo habe mel bo lol Deus le ha fel ngo tor dermi mo lal faileng le ye ssogol rechokla re tayikof ngo re toa hamolfid. Habe wochog fis kala ye werloh lal laeng le habe werloh luwullur,

irel yodla habe kangalur kofael molow la tor siyal. Hare be iye sengal le ha foru, ila ngo be yor fal le ibe cchehas iremi irel Ralla be tefaeldoh Kristus, bo fael mala be llah le pangal yedamgel mo yengang kowe iforu ngo yor pelal.
Malbo ngang ibe mes ngo be ser cchay wol maligach la hami ha fang ngal Deus bo fal mala ye tugul lal dipmi irel. Hare be ila sengal, ngo ngang isa rraey ngo ibe kangalugmi pangmiloh lepal yai rraey.
Be wol iye sengal chog yami rraey ngo habe dabeyey irel rraey.
Timothy Mo Epaphroditus
Hare iye mele depel Samol ngo idipli le ibe fangwey Timothy iremi bo hare ibe gola kofmi, ila ngo be kkel loh lal depey.
Bo hal iy mele ye sew chog yamem luluwal ngo ye kkel depal le ye be tupungugmi.
Sa semal ngo ye luluwaley chog kofal llufulyal ngo te luluwaley loh mekla Jesus Kristus ye dipliy sibe foru.
Hami ngo hasa gola le ye palleng pelal Timothy, le yesa wochog bo iy layi, ngo ngang mele temal irel yal dedabeyey irel yengangel Hapatpat Momay we.
Iluluwaley bo ibe rel gola mele rebe for ngalyey ngo isa fangwey Timothy iremi.
Ngo ngang ye luglug depey ngal Samol le be yoh le ngang ibe buyoy iremi lal seral ka.
Iluluwaley ngo ye palleng pelal le ibe fangwey Epaphroditus we bisich iremi. Icholuway irel yengangel hammalel Hapatpat Momay we, ngo iy mele re kekkal yalomi le ye budoh tipingiyey.
Sa cchang depal be wurugmi pangmi, ngo ye tay fel depal irel molwe ye la gola bo hami ha rongrong bo iy ye tomay.
Ye katos bo ye tomay le ye memmel be mes. Ngo ligdi bo Deus ye fahoy, ngo ye wol fahoyey. Iwe sala foru le towe kkel yal tayikof depey.
Ila yesa kkel depey le ibe fangwey iy iremi bo fael mala habe wiri bo habe rraey, ila ngo yebe chuyloh yal tayikof depey.
Ha hamomayi yami hagiyeg ngali luwul yami rraey bo fael mala iy ila semal bismi irel Samol. Ha hasrowur panger rechokla re wochog yeramtale,
bo fal mala ye fang yal ngas le sa fesugfed ngo sa mes bo fael yengang la yael Kristus, bo be tipingiyey irel mekla hami ye teyoh le habe tipingiyey iyang.
